leaderboard.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (same priors as the totals desk) evaluated on the priced AH line (quarter lines split half/half); bets the side whose model EV beats the margin-removed market EV by >= 3% per unit staked, and only when the model EV itself is positive. Pre-registered priors, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Poisson Asian-handicap value

leaderboard.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (Maher/Dixon-Coles family; league rates + shrunk attack/defence multipliers from released matches only, prior weight 6 matches) vs the margin-removed market over/under 2.5 price; bets the side with a >= 3% edge. Pre-registered priors, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Poisson totals value (O/U 2.5)

leaderboard.description: Back the better recent-form side (mean points per match over last 3 released matches) when the gap >= 1.0 pts/match and the stored price >= 1.80. Tipster-style rule, fully auditable, no fitted parameters.
leaderboard.name: Form + price value

leaderboard.description: Draw mispricing probe: back DRAW when the Elo 3-way model's draw probability exceeds the margin-removed market draw probability by >= 3%. Research prior, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Draw value probe

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite side of the priced Asian handicap. Baseline reference for the AH family, not a claimed edge.
leaderboard.name: Market AH favourite (baseline)

leaderboard.description: Elo ratings (K=40, home adv 60); backs the model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed market >= 3%. No edge -> no bet.
leaderboard.name: Elo value edge

leaderboard.description: Home bias probe: back HOME only when the Elo model's home probability exceeds the margin-removed market price by >= 5% (deliberately selective). Research prior, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Home-advantage value probe

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite side of the over/under 2.5 goals market. Baseline reference for the totals family, not a claimed edge.
leaderboard.name: Market totals favourite (O/U 2.5 baseline)

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite (highest implied probability). Baseline reference, not a claimed edge.
leaderboard.name: Market favourite (baseline)

leaderboard.description: Elo-based: back the 2-way leader when p_draw < 0.30 and max(p_home,p_away) >= 0.55; a draw loses (DNB rule).
leaderboard.name: Draw-No-Bet decisive

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed least-favoured team outcome (min of home/away implied probabilities; draw excluded). Tests the favourite-longshot bias on the pilot sample.
leaderboard.name: Market longshot probe (baseline)
